sections.heading: Connect an AI model to chat
paragraphs: Miggi is free. You need your own OpenAI API key with available credits, or a compatible local model through Ollama. Cloud API usage is billed separately.
Choose a cloud or local connection. AI replies are unavailable until a model is configured.

sections.heading: Billing and usage
paragraphs: Miggi does not include prepaid cloud AI. API billing is between you and OpenAI under its terms; available credits may cover some usage.
Costs depend on the model, request and selected context size, output, and tools. Dictation, file study, and enabled background processing can also incur API charges.
Check the provider’s Usage and Billing pages. Configure available spending alerts and controls, and review automatic recharge settings. A budget alert is not a guaranteed hard spending cap.
